info.title: DoorKing Gate Manager API
info.description:
The routes a **gate API key** can use. A gate admin creates keys in the web page (System Settings → API keys); each key belongs to one gate and has a role: **read only** (view, pull, cameras) or **admin** (also changes, sends and relays).

Send the key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (click **Authorize**). `{phone}` must be the key's gate. Changes to residents and settings go to the **working copy**; nothing reaches the gate until `POST /send`. Only `POST /send` and `PUT /relays` change the gate itself.

Gate login, gate users, API keys, deleting the gate's data and accounts are web-page only. Full reference: `docs/API.md` in the repository.

200.description: The gate as this key sees it (role: the key's role).

get.description:
Poll this after `POST /pull` or `POST /send` (every few seconds) until `state` is done or failed. One connection runs at a time across all gates.

**Read-only or admin key.**

post.description:
Reads residents or transactions from the gate through DKS Cloud (takes a minute or more). Progress: `GET /job`.

**Read-only or admin key.**

get.description:
What `POST /send` would change.

**Read-only or admin key.**

post.summary: Send the working copy to the gate
post.description:
**Changes the gate.** Sends the changed blocks, then pulls residents to check the gate holds them. Refused (409) with duplicates, conflicts not yet decided, or a missing working copy.

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

get.description:
The transaction history, newest first, with names from the working copy.

**Read-only or admin key.**

The working copy (what the gate holds plus unsent changes).

**Read-only or admin key.**

post.description:
Fills a vacant code or inserts a new one in the working copy (sent with `POST /send`).

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

put.description:
Only the fields given change (working copy). An entry code or card held by another code is refused (409).

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

delete.description:
The code stays as an empty unit.

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

put.description:
Up to 500 characters, kept in this app only (never on the gate). Blank clears it.

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

delete.description:
Takes the code off the gate entirely (working copy).

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

put.summary: Change the number of digits in directory codes
put.description:
Decreasing **wipes all residents** and needs `confirm: true`.

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

get.description:
Every decoded setting: working-copy value and the gate's value. Secret values are masked.

**Read-only or admin key.**

put.description:
Saves editable fields to the working copy (sent with `POST /send`). Keys as in `GET /settings`.

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

get.description:
Whether anything is unsent, the changed blocks per file, and the conflicts to decide. Each residents pull updates the working copy at once, with unsent changes kept on top.

**Read-only or admin key.**

conflicts.description: changes to decide before a send

delete.description:
Throws away unsent changes and conflicts: the working copy becomes what the gate holds (the last pull).

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

get.description:
The working copy's names.bin (contains the master code), phone.bin, cards.bin or a .map.

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

Kept in this app only, never sent to the gate.

**Read-only or admin key.**

put.description:
Any of the keys; `relayLabels` changes only the relays given. Changing `gateConfig.areaCodes` converts the working copy (409 when it can't).

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

get.description:
Up to 500 events, newest first, and the gate's users. Key actions show as `api:<key name>`.

**Read-only or admin key.**

post.description:
Undoes that change in the working copy; refused (409) when a later change touched the same data or it was reverted already.

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

get.description:
Asks the gate now (DKS GetRelays). Each call reaches the gate: don't poll it often.

**Read-only or admin key.**

put.description:
**Changes the gate now** (DKS SetRelays). `true` = Active (held open) until set back to `false`. Allowed: relays 0-2 (except a Tracker command relay), 3-10 with Tracker 2, 11-18 with Tracker 1.

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

post.description:
Runs on the server at the given days and time (server local time), with the gate's DKS login.

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

put.description: **Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

delete.description: **Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

post.description:
Queues it after any running connection; its next time is unchanged.

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

get.description:
Never includes the recorder password.

**Read-only or admin key.**

put.description:
A blank `password` keeps the saved one.

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

delete.description:
Saved pictures are kept.

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

post.summary: Test: a live picture per channel
post.description:
Pictures are then at `/snapshots/live/ch<N>.jpg`.

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

get.description: A multipart MJPEG stream (for an ``); `?quality=high` for the main stream. **Read-only or admin key.**

Per transaction minute (match a transaction's `minute`), and the current or last run.

**Read-only or admin key.**

delete.description:
And the snapshot log.

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

post.description:
For pending transactions, or only `minute`. Never for gate data transfers (RS232, modem), hold-open events (Hold Begin / Hold End), anti-pass back maintenance (Re-Sync, Counter) and System relay commands other than a momentary open (System Admit): 400 for a minute with only those.

**Read-only or admin key.**

get.description:
JPEG, or MP4 (supports Range requests).

**Read-only or admin key.**

post.description:
Keeps the working copy's value (`mine`) or takes the gate's (`gate`, saved like an edit; recorded in History).

**Admin key only** (403 for a read-only key).

200.description: The working copy status, as GET .../working-copy.

conflicts.description: changes to decide before a send

apiKey.description: A gate API key from System Settings → API keys.

phone.name: phone
phone.description: The gate's system phone number, digits only. Must be the key's gate.

code.name: code
code.description: Directory code; shorter codes get leading zeros to the gate's digit count.

Unauthorized.description: No, wrong, expired or revoked API key.

Forbidden.description: The key is for another gate, or a read-only key tried an admin operation.

NotFound.description: Not found (e.g. no working copy yet: pull residents first).

Conflict.description: Conflict: a gate connection or snapshot run is running, duplicates, a revert refused, …

Upstream.description: DKS Cloud, the gate or the camera recorder didn't answer as expected.

user.description: who started it (username, or api:<key name>)

changedBlocks.description: 128-byte blocks that would be sent, per file

note.description: local note, never on the gate

areaCode.description: 3 digits, or 4 as 1 + area code for long distance

edited.description: the working copy has changes not sent to the gate

conflicts.description: changes to decide before a send

editable.description: false = read-only: the master code and the settings decoded but not yet confirmed for writing (dialType, multipleSystems, systemMemory, memoryChips, downloadStamp1, downloadStamp2)

camera.description: camera footage can apply: false for gate data transfers (RS232, modem), hold-open events (Hold Begin / Hold End), anti-pass back maintenance (Re-Sync, Counter) and System relay commands other than a momentary open (System Admit)

Conflict.description: An item changed differently at the gate and in the working copy since the last pull. The working copy keeps its value until it is decided (POST .../working-copy/conflicts); sends are refused (409) until then.

key.description: directory code, card slot or setting key

gate.description: the gate's value, in words (only what differs)

mine.description: the working copy's value, in words
